children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The first audio block at 0x0 gives no sample rate in its flags (index 15) and holds no sample rate sub-block with a rate above 0; libwavpack then takes 44100 Hz.
The sample rate sub-block at 0x80 gives 0 Hz, which libwavpack ignores in favor of the rate in the flags.
